capabilities: Generate flowcharts and mind maps with AI on an infinite canvas
Draw freehand and build to-do lists, timetables and charts on whiteboards
Insert whiteboards into notes via command or context menu
Export boards to pdf, png and ppt
Save and sync files through a moredraw.com account
extras: Relies on the remote moredraw.com service; some features require an account there and some are paid, so content and availability depend on that external service.
problem: Obsidian's built-in canvas does not generate diagrams from AI or offer drawing tools like free pen, chart and QR code makers.
summary: Infinite-canvas whiteboard that uses AI to generate flowcharts, mind maps and other diagrams, plus to-dos, charts and exports.
